method: Subpixel alpha-isocontour (marching squares), no hand-drawn outline or fitted ellipse.
smoothing: Gaussian contour smoothing, sigma 1.2 source pixels, uniform 0.5-pixel arc-length samples, to remove raster stair steps.
vectorMethod: Cubic Bezier fit to original logo contours; additional 2-source-pixel contour smoothing removes compression waviness; max fitting distance 0.7 source pixels. Original proportions, holes and placement are preserved.
